digest.component_or_area: binding store rotation and persistence layer
propositions: After a successful new-writer save, the last_get_pass inline field must be absent from every entry in bindings.json while the chronological maximum is durable in get_rotation.json.
When sidecar (get_rotation.json) persistence fails, the primary bindings save must succeed with the latest inline timestamp preserved as a failure floor.
A crash or failure after the sidecar replace but before the bindings replace cannot lose the maximum rotation value; the maximum must already be durable in the sidecar.
An old-writer followed by a new-writer sequence must converge such that a later inline stamp introduced by the legacy writer is promoted to get_rotation.json and scrubbed from bindings.json.

The save contract must enforce ordering: merge staged inline values into sidecar using chronological max, atomically persist get_rotation.json, then remove inline fields and atomically write bindings.json only after sidecar persistence succeeds.
